headlines.headline: NCAA PROPOSES NEW AGE-BASED ELIGIBILITY CLOCK; VOTE EXPECTED BY MONTH END
headlines.detail: Division I Cabinet modifies proposal to start clocks at full-time enrollment or age 19 academic year, whichever is sooner. Vote expected before June 30.

headlines.headline: KNICKS LEAD FINALS 2-0; GAME 3 TONIGHT AT MADISON SQUARE GARDEN
headlines.detail: New York's 13-game postseason streak is second-longest in NBA history. Game 2 drew 16.93M viewers on ABC, up 90% from last year. Tip-off 8:30 PM ET.

headlines.headline: MANDATORY MINICAMP OPENS ACROSS NFL; PENIX KNEE RECOVERY ON TRACK
headlines.detail: All 32 teams report this week. Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. hitting every rehab milestone. Cardinals QB Brissett attending to avoid fines while seeking new contract.

headlines.headline: COURT RESTORES TEXAS TECH QB SORSBY'S ELIGIBILITY FOR 2026 SEASON
headlines.detail: District court in Lubbock grants injunction for Brendan Sorsby. 12-team CFP enters Year 3 this fall with opener Aug. 29.
